mechanism_evaluation_dataset: existing common frozen Dataset B pool (E2)
inner_split: one deterministic 48/16 source holdout per outer 64-source training set
selection: conditional on fixed outer-training M1/M2; independent calibration; natural then interference then CF
task_weighting: uniform over reliable original natural training nodes, as archived intercept fitting
AP_weighting: equal A/P total; equal sources within kind; equal pairs within kind/source; sum=1
center: uniform mean of natural training traces, no feature rescaling
task_normalization: mean BCE / max(mean baseline BCE at fixed train b0,1e-12)
AP_normalization: weighted corrected pair difference squared / max(weighted raw difference squared,1)
regularizer: 0.01 * sum(w**2), same S/J; differs in relative scale from historical sum-weight E1
calibration: separate shared b0 and own intercept, same natural training IDs
inference: original final-token scores and original dynamic path scorer
primary: independent J-S, then independent J-R1; fixed sequence; two success conditions each
additional_comparisons: shared comparisons, J-R2 and S-R1 exploratory

groups.E0: reuse historical full fit and five-fold M1/M2; compute only missing five-fold constrained M3 and intercept
groups.E1: balanced frozen A; equal category and within-category source weighting
groups.E2: full frozen B; equal category and within-category source weighting
groups.E3: full frozen B; natural pair weights

source_cv.calibration: same historical natural fit nodes restricted to training sources

model_data_metadata.preprocessing: one existence/count/field/source check; no generation or semantic rereview; no hashes
model_data_metadata.cache_policy: exact input text, model, system prompt, tokenizer, final-token score and FP32 projection match; cache raw activations and pairwise exact patch scores; learned estimates remain fold specific
model_data_metadata.historical_eval_policy: 40 historical test sources and 60 previously used new sources are reused evaluation; no claim of independent confirmation
user_steering: do not rerun experiments already completed
model_data_metadata.monitoring: stopped after stable startup; controller continues workflow and writes final report

speed_optimization.multirow_patch_reason: Observed BF16 batch-shape score difference up to 0.356 logit; keep original single-input shapes
speed_optimization.extraction_concurrency_decision: single process per authorized GPU; two processes did not improve measured throughput
speed_optimization.patch_scheduler: four GPUs claim different pair jobs; no whole-group lockstep

scheduling.policy: global dynamic queue of distinct raw input-pair interventions; CPU estimates remain independent for every group and source fold
scheduling.deduplication: union candidates only for computation; finalize each plan with its own candidates, training pairs and weights
scheduling.immutable_prefix_read: concurrent read; lock only when creating absent prefix
scheduling.cpu_module_fits: parallel with four-GPU development feature extraction
